purpose: Parent-facing pointers to public young-learner English resources. Not sent verbatim to the LLM; used for manual curation and future updates to playbook_age4_read_along.md.

references.name: BBC Learning English - The English We Speak (simple phrases)
references.note: Short phrase lessons; pick very simple episodes for adults to preview, not for 4yo alone.

references.name: British Council - LearnEnglish Kids
references.note: Songs, stories, games; good for parent to choose one story/song per week as pasted material.

references.name: Oxford Owl - Free eBooks (Read with Oxford)
references.note: Graded readers; Level 1+ for parent-led read-aloud; paste short pages into the app.

references.name: Cambridge English - Activities for children
references.note: Activity ideas; align home play with call rhythm (short, repeatable).

methodology_keywords: phonics listening (not drilling rules at age 4)
